title: Seamless Restaurant System Integration for Daily Labor Management and Forecasting
text: The system's ability to integrate with other restaurant systems makes it easier to connect with the existing restaurant systems. Managers use it on a daily basis for labor management and forecasting, thus encouraging regular user adoption in the regions. The system's interface is not flexible enough for ad-hoc enterprise reporting. Altametrics offers enterprise-wide labor and food forecasting, allowing the enterprise to monitor labor and food performance trends and proactively manage costs for hundreds of locations.

author: Tina D.
title: Seamless Implementation and Simple Adoption with Accurate Labor Forecasting
text: Altametrics offers a seamless implementation process with well-identified milestones. The go-live time is reasonable, and the user adoption rate is high because of the simplicity of the system. The accuracy of labor forecasting increases substantially with the continued use of the system. Some users need training to effectively use the sophisticated forecasting functionality. Altametrics allows more accurate forecasting of labor and food demand, thus eliminating last-minute changes in labor and food shortages, and also improving the predictability of costs.

author: Alvin W.
title: Altametrics Delivers Clear Food Cost Insights with Integrated Ordering and Inventory
text: Altametrics is a platform that integrates ordering, forecasting, and inventory tracking. The system offers clear insights into food cost performance and supports recipe-based inventory. For smaller teams, advanced reporting options may seem overwhelming. Guesswork in ordering and manual inventory tracking are replaced by Altametrics. This lowers waste, increases inventory accuracy, and improves leadership's understanding of food costs.
